data.what_it_does: Provides the Windows-specific implementation of the shared_preferences plugin to store simple data in key-value pairs. It acts as an endorsed federated plugin that is automatically included when using the main shared_preferences package.
use_when: You are developing a Flutter application for Windows that needs simple key-value storage.
You are using the shared_preferences package and need Windows support.
avoid_when: You are building apps that do not target Windows.
You need complex relational queries or secure data encryption.
strengths: Automatically included when using the endorsed shared_preferences package.
Native Windows implementation for persistent key-value data.
weaknesses: Limited to simple key-value data types.
Not suitable for secure storage needs.
data.setup_notes: Endorsed plugin, so it is automatically included when using shared_preferences without requiring manual addition to pubspec.yaml unless using its APIs directly.

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: When you need to store sensitive data securely on Windows.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: When you need relational database storage instead of simple key-value pairs.

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: When you want a fast, pure Dart NoSQL key-value database.
